question: The part of the Himalayas lying between Satluj and Kali rivers is known as _______.
solution:
Correct Answer **Kumaon Himalayas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__Divisions of Himalayas: __The Himalayas have also been divided on the basis of regions from west to east.

These are Punjab Himalayas, Kumaon Himalaya, Nepal Himalayas, and Assam Himalaya.

__
 
• The divisions of the Himalayas that have been demarcated by the river valleys are:

 
 

 Nepal Himalayas
 The part of the Himalayas lying between the rivers Kali and Teesta is known as the Nepal Himalayas.
 
 

 Kumaon Himalayas
 The part of the Himalayas lying between the rivers Satluj and Kali is known as the Kumaon Himalayas.
 
 

 Assam Himalayas
 The part of the Himalayas lying between the rivers Teesta and Dihang is known as the Assam Himalayas.
 
 

 Punjab Himalayas.
 
 
The part of the Himalayas lying between the rivers Indus and Satluj is known as the Punjab Himalayas.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The main Himalayan river systems are those of the Indus and the **Ganga-Brahmaputra-Meghna system.**
 
• The Indus, which is one of the great rivers of the world, rises near Mansarovar in Tibet and flows through India, and thereafter through Pakistan, and finally falls in the Arabian Sea near Karachi.
 
• The Brahmaputra marks the easternmost boundary of the Himalayas. Beyond the Dihang gorge, the Himalayas bend sharply to the south and spread along the eastern boundary of India.
 
• To the south of the main Himalayas lies the Pir Panjal Range at an average height of 5,000 meters (16,000 ft).
 
• From Gulmarg, in the northwest, it follows the southern rim of the Kashmir valley to the Banihal Pass.
 
• Here the Pir Panjal meets the ridgeline that separates the Kashmir valley from the Warvan Valley.
